name: Lyra
author: Project Lyra
description: A persistent jailbreak and modding platform for the Zune HD: the mod manager UI, zuxhook, nativeapp daemon, and its component mods (mods-tab, wifi-power, clock-date) all wrapped in a pretty bow.
changelog: Browse now says why the mod list is empty instead of sitting on Loading. No connection, a wrong clock with the setting to fix it, a repo error, and a mod service that is not running each get their own message and a code to quote when reporting a problem.
